data.rationale: time_before relies on this postcondition to prove its own postcondition: ensures \result == (a.ts.tv_sec < b.ts.tv_sec || (a.ts.tv_sec == b.ts.tv_sec && a.ts.tv_nsec < b.ts.tv_nsec)). Without it the call-site VO (call_site_2) cannot be discharged once time_less_ publishes.
